test.title: The town that kept its clock

paragraphs.text: In 1890 the small town of Harwick bought a large mechanical clock for the tower of its market hall. The money was raised by residents, who paid for the clock through a series of concerts and a public dinner.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: For almost a century, a local family looked after the clock. Every Sunday one of them climbed the tower to wind it by hand, a job that took about forty minutes.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: In 1985 the council proposed replacing the mechanism with an electric motor. Many residents objected, arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity, and the plan was dropped after a public vote.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Today volunteers wind the clock, and visitors can join them on the first Sunday of each month. The town estimates that the tours attract around two thousand visitors a year.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: The town that kept its clock

items.quote: arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity
items.prompt: a reason given for keeping a traditional practice

explanation.en: The reason for keeping hand-winding is in paragraph C: residents objected, “arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity” → C. Paragraph B describes the winding too, but gives no reason to keep it.
explanation.kk: Қолмен бұрау дәстүрін сақтау себебі C абзацында: тұрғындар қарсы шығып, «arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity» → C. B абзацында да бұрау сипатталады, бірақ оны сақтау себебі жоқ.
explanation.ru: Причина сохранить ручной завод — в абзаце C: жители возражали, «arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity» → C. В абзаце B завод тоже описан, но без причины его сохранять.

items.quote: The money was raised by residents, who paid for the clock through a series of concerts and a public dinner
items.prompt: how the original purchase was paid for

explanation.en: The 1890 purchase was funded by residents: “The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts and a public dinner” → A. “Paid for” paraphrases “money was raised”.
explanation.kk: 1890 жылы сағатты тұрғындар қаржыландырған: «The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts and a public dinner» → A. «Paid for» — «money was raised» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы.
explanation.ru: Покупка часов в 1890 году оплачена жителями: «The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts and a public dinner» → A. «Paid for» пересказывает «money was raised».

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. The reading passage has four paragraphs, A–D. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D.

steps.en: Identify the kind of information: “a reason” — we need a paragraph that explains why something was kept.
steps.kk: Ақпарат түрін анықтаймыз: «a reason» — бір нәрсені неге сақтағаны түсіндірілетін абзац керек.
steps.ru: Определяем тип информации: «a reason» — нужен абзац, где объясняется, почему что-то сохранили.

steps.en: Answers in this type are not in order, so read paragraph by paragraph and look for an explanation, not matching words.
steps.kk: Бұл түрде жауаптар ретімен жүрмейді, сондықтан абзацтарды бір-бірлеп оқып, бірдей сөзді емес, түсіндірмені іздейміз.
steps.ru: Ответы в этом типе не идут по порядку, поэтому читаем абзацы по одному и ищем объяснение, а не одинаковые слова.

steps.en: B describes the winding but not why it should be kept. In C residents argue “that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity”.
steps.kk: B сағатты қалай бұрағанын сипаттайды, бірақ оны неге сақтау керегін айтпайды. C абзацында тұрғындар дәлел келтіреді: «arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity».
steps.ru: B описывает, как заводили часы, но не говорит, зачем это сохранять. В C жители спорят: «arguing that the weekly winding had become part of the town’s identity».

steps.en: This paragraph has both the tradition and the reason to keep it → C.
steps.kk: Мұнда дәстүр де, оны сақтау себебі де бар → C.
steps.ru: Здесь есть и традиция, и причина её сохранить → C.

steps.en: The item is about money: “how the original purchase was paid for”. Look for the purchase and where the money came from.
steps.kk: Тармақ ақша туралы: «how the original purchase was paid for». Сатып алу мен ақша көзін іздейміз.
steps.ru: Пункт о деньгах: «how the original purchase was paid for». Ищем покупку и источник денег.

steps.en: The purchase is in paragraph A: “In 1890 the small town of Harwick bought a large mechanical clock”.
steps.kk: Сағатты сатып алу — A абзацында: «In 1890 the small town of Harwick bought a large mechanical clock».
steps.ru: Покупка часов — в абзаце A: «In 1890 the small town of Harwick bought a large mechanical clock».

steps.en: Right after: “The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts”. That is how it was paid for → A.
steps.kk: Одан кейін бірден: «The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts». Бұл — төлеу тәсілі → A.
steps.ru: Сразу за этим: «The money was raised by residents … through a series of concerts». Это и есть способ оплаты → A.
